mapper.select: SELECT id, type, label, lng, lat, version, updated_at, properties FROM network_elements WHERE ST_Within(location, ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326)) AND (#{types} IS NULL OR type = ANY(#{types}::text[])) AND (#{propFilter} IS NULL OR properties @> #{propFilter}::jsonb)

SELECT id, type, label, lng, lat, version, updated_at, properties FROM network_elements WHERE (label ILIKE #{query} OR type ILIKE #{query}) AND (#{types} IS NULL OR type = ANY(#{types}::text[])) LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM network_elements WHERE (label ILIKE #{query} OR type ILIKE #{query}) AND (#{types} IS NULL OR type = ANY(#{types}::text[]))
